title: No Editor Needed: Every Feature Gets an Auto Demo Clip | vitalii.no
description:
Filming or hand-editing a demo clip for every published feature didn't scale -- with dozens of features shipping across multiple projects, manual video production would have become the bottleneck instead of the code itself. Features either had no visual media at all or relied on whatever screenshot happened to be lying around.

I added demo media columns to the features table and built a component to render them inline. Clips are generated procedurally through a Remotion template built from shared primitives and a common theme, composed from feature data instead of hand-keyframed one at a time. Two pilot compositions, built for two unrelated features, proved the same primitives produce visually distinct clips just by changing the data fed in.

Features can now ship with a visual demo clip by default instead of by exception. Two pilot clips proved the template generalizes, and the clip catalog has been growing on its own ever since, without anyone touching a video editor.
